name: std::chrono::weekday::operator++, std::chrono::weekday::operator--
intro:
Adds or subtracts 1 from the weekday value, reducing the result modulo 7 to an integer in the range [0, 6].

1,2) Performs *this += std::chrono::days{1};.

3,4) Performs *this -= std::chrono::days{1};.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
1,3) A reference to this weekday after modification.

2,4) A copy of the weekday made before modification.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: After a call to one of these functions, ok() is always true.

summary: Adds or subtracts 1 from the weekday value, reducing the result modulo 7 to an integer in the range [0, 6].
